Hiring Team
Zerwaste

Dear Zerwaste Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Digital Marketing & Growth Intern position at Zerwaste. Your company’s mission to foster innovation through talent and technology for a sustainable future deeply resonates with my own professional aspirations. As a Junior Digital Marketer with a robust technical background, I am particularly drawn to this opportunity to contribute to online content creation, inbound campaigns, and the development of new marketing concepts to drive growth.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own the full cycle of on-page SEO, from keyword research to content publishing, significantly improving organic visibility and search rankings for clients. I regularly write keyword-targeted blog content, build and maintain WordPress sites, and track performance using Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. My independent project, mirook.com, further showcases my proactive approach to implementing advanced structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to enhance visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines – skills I believe are directly applicable to researching and implementing growth hacking techniques at Zerwaste.

I am keen to develop my understanding of inbound and growth hacking marketing strategies, as well as streamline operations and prevent digital marketing malfunctions, aligning perfectly with the learning opportunities you provide. My technical foundation, including prior experience as a Front-End Developer, combined with strong writing skills and proficiency in content management systems like WordPress, positions me well to take on diverse responsibilities, from content creation (articles, videos, photos) to managing corporate events. While my native languages are Turkish and English, my Dutch is B1 and continuously improving, ensuring effective communication with various stakeholders.

Thank you for considering my application. I am confident that my blend of digital marketing experience, technical aptitude, and genuine passion for learning and growth would make me a valuable asset to Zerwaste. I am eager to learn more about this role and discuss how I can contribute to your innovative team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

## Profile
Proactive Junior Digital Marketer with a robust technical foundation in web design, SEO, and cutting-edge Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). My experience includes managing on-page SEO, developing keyword-targeted content, and end-to-end WordPress site development and maintenance. On personal projects, I've successfully applied structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to significantly enhance online visibility for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am adept at content management, social media integration, and performance reporting, with a keen interest in inbound marketing, growth hacking techniques, and leveraging technology to drive digital growth. Committed to continuous learning and fluent in English, with improving Dutch skills (B1).

- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)

- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads

- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design
